description: Training configuration of every run of the main SAE-vs-DualSAE comparison (TopK/BatchTopK/JumpReLU and Matryoshka/Gated pairs, 3 encoders x 2 datasets x seeds 42/43/44). `args` are the main.py arguments of the run (paths, --exp_name and --output_dir are added by scripts/main/train_cells.py). The Matryoshka/Gated entries are the final cells of the selection procedure in scripts/main/stage_cells.py.
